# krabka

> krabka is an Apache 2.0 broker in safe Rust. It is compatible with the Kafka wire protocol. It has its own KRaft quorum and clients for Rust, Go, and Java.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://krabka.io/docs/): Start here. The broker, the KRaft quorum, clients, stream processing, connectors, and the Kubernetes operator.
- [Quickstart](https://krabka.io/docs/quickstart/): Start a local broker. Create a topic. Produce and read a record.
- [Migrate from Kafka](https://krabka.io/docs/migration/): The differences from Apache Kafka, and how to move a running Kafka cluster to krabka.
- [KIP matrix](https://krabka.io/docs/kip-matrix/): The implementation status of each Kafka Improvement Proposal.

## Project

- [Verification](https://krabka.io/verification/): How krabka checks correctness: no unsafe Rust, proved kernels, and bounded models.
- [Benchmarks](https://krabka.io/benchmarks/): OpenMessaging Benchmark results for krabka, Apache Kafka, and Redpanda, with the method.
- [Versions](https://krabka.io/versions/): Release status, Kafka wire compatibility targets, and runtime requirements.
- [Brand](https://krabka.io/brand/): The krabka marks and colors, with a stable URL for each file.
- [GitHub organization](https://github.com/krabka-io): The source code for all krabka repositories.
